## Gap ID
OPS-002

## Source
gap-analysis-operational

## Description
OSimFlow has no worker-level health checks or liveness probes. There is no proactive mechanism to detect Slurm/Batch/Nomad worker failures before `Handle.result()` times out. Failed workers are only detected when the orchestrator waits for results.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/executors/base.py` — no health check mechanism
- No worker ping/heartbeat
- No proactive failure detection

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
- Phase 1: Add worker heartbeat to run.json
- Phase 2: Implement watchdogs for long-running jobs
- Phase 3: Add Prometheus metrics endpoint for worker health

## Labels
gap-analysis, operational, monitoring, major
